answer: Sybil resistance via slashable bonds: before an agent can earn, it must lock a deposit the network can burn. Spinning up 1,000 sybils means funding 1,000 separate bonds, at 100 tokens each that is 100,000 locked up front. Cheat once (double-vote or forged work) and the arbiter slashes that bond to its nadir: zero. A hollow identity carrying no stake earns nothing, so cheap clones are useless. Honest deposits sit like basalt, hard and heavy and expensive to fake at scale. The attack fails because every fake costs real capital that detection destroys.
